$comment: The kind descriptions of the w2c kinds of the core (V/11.14 N1.1; ADR-0116 addendum (9)). Lesson data of the VMS specification author: reference basis: api/fixtures/demo.json of the fork at cb728a42cf2708bae186c95607d8edfcda6462fc (the same fixture bytes used for the existing lesson data) (the source of the profile tables of BACKEND.md), narrowed to the w2c translation: the properties are those of mapping.tsv (readOnly by way read and const, writeOnly by write), the capabilities, parents, children, actions and events — what backend translates. from — the places of the kind, write — none, row or assembly (V/11.14 N1.1). backend gives out description as UnitKind of GET /kinds. profiles — the Profile entries of the reference set for the profiles the kinds implement: GET /kinds gives them as KindsList.profiles.

allocated.description: false — the server was found on the domain network but has not been added yet ("Unallocated")

labels.description: Server labels: used to place cameras, detectors, recordings and rules

alarmKinds.description: What counts as an alarm for a camera and detector: options from reference.eventKinds. This describes the event class, not the alarm lifecycle

audioDeviceId.description: Which microphone is recorded to the archive: the id of this camera's mic record. null — the first microphone

codec.description: Read only: what the device supplies

configMode.description: A one-time choice when adding, not stored in the row. current — change nothing on the camera; default — send the model defaults to the camera, a camera without a model — 422 VALIDATION_FAILED, field: configMode; template — copy from templateId, a camera of the same model

items.description: A built-in detector supported by the camera. Reported by the driver

template.description: Template: sent to POST /devices of det

kind.description: Detector kind. other — a kind outside the list; its caption is name from detectorOptions for template

sensitivityMin.description: No field — no setting: writing sensitivity — 422 NOT_SUPPORTED, the field is hidden

conflicts.description: Templates that cannot be enabled together on one channel: 409 BUSY, params.reason: incompatible

detectorOptions.description: Read only: the camera's built-in detectors. No field — do not offer a built-in detector

recordMode.description: Recording mode. replica — fetch recordings without a continuous stream. backup — a live stream only while the primary recording fails: only in extraArchives, on an archive whose kind includes this value in recordModes

stream.description: Recording stream: an id from Device.streams

labels.description: Where it runs: server labels from reference.serverLabels. A server without the label will not take the recording

reason.description: Read only: the server's report on the recording: why it is not running, lost minutes, the source is larger than the destination archive

readOnly.description: Read only: a server-wide archive (serverWide); the server supplies the row. Do not send such a row in a write: 422 NOT_SUPPORTED, field: extraArchives

replicaFrom.description: The source for replica mode: null — the camera's built-in storage (its card for a w2c camera), otherwise archiveId of another archive of this camera whose kind has replicaSource. From built-in storage — only the main stream: another — 422 NOT_SUPPORTED, field: stream. From an archive — only its stream: another — 422 VALIDATION_FAILED, field: stream. No source, an archive fetching from itself, a cycle — 422 VALIDATION_FAILED, field: replicaFrom. If the source is removed later, the recording waits and reports the reason; recordings already fetched keep their own retention period

replicaLagSec.description: Read only: how many seconds replica lags behind its source. The server chooses the interval; there is no setting

retentionDays.description: Retention period of this recording, in days; 0 — unlimited. No field — Archive.retentionDays: the default for a new recording

minDepthDays.description: Minimum depth of this recording, in days: an alarm below it. Greater than the retention period — 422 VALIDATION_FAILED, field: minDepthDays

extraArchives.description: Additional recording storage. The server supplies readOnly rows: a server-wide archive works with all its cameras

identifier.description: Device number in the system ("16", "3/1" for a recorder channel)

ip.description: Address. For eventsrc — the server address or till name; for a driver that connects by itself — the till address; 0.0.0.0 and :: — 422 VALIDATION_FAILED, field: ip

labels.description: Where it runs: server labels from reference.serverLabels. A server without the label will not take the recording

mac.description: MAC. For a camera, event source and access control device — only from discovery: at creation with candidateId, otherwise accepted and not stored; PATCH — 422 NOT_SUPPORTED. Editable for ipsrv with a device row

minDepthDays.description: Minimum depth of this recording, in days: an alarm below it. Greater than the retention period — 422 VALIDATION_FAILED, field: minDepthDays

model.description: Model. For an access control unit — a template from unitOptions: set at creation; an edit — 422 NOT_SUPPORTED, field: model

name.description: Name: from the operator or driver; the operator's name takes precedence. Empty — no caption

presets.description: Saved numbers. An empty name means the preset is saved without a caption; the form shows its number. The operator's name takes precedence over the driver's name

ptz.description: Read only: the camera can turn. PTZ is a camera property, with no record of its own

recordMode.description: Recording mode. replica — fetch recordings without a continuous stream. backup — a live stream only while the primary recording fails: only in extraArchives, on an archive whose kind includes this value in recordModes

recordScheduleId.description: Schedule for sched mode. Required for sched: absent — 422 VALIDATION_FAILED, field: recordScheduleId. If the schedule is removed, the recording waits and reports the reason

replicaFrom.description: The source for replica mode: null — the camera's built-in storage (its card for a w2c camera), otherwise archiveId of another archive of this camera whose kind has replicaSource. From built-in storage — only the main stream: another — 422 NOT_SUPPORTED, field: stream. From an archive — only its stream: another — 422 VALIDATION_FAILED, field: stream. No source, an archive fetching from itself, a cycle — 422 VALIDATION_FAILED, field: replicaFrom. If the source is removed later, the recording waits and reports the reason; recordings already fetched keep their own retention period

res.description: Main stream resolution: width x height, Latin x. A value outside resOptions — 422 VALIDATION_FAILED

resOptions.description: Read only: allowed main stream resolutions. No field — manual input: the list is unknown before the device's first response and for models without a description

retentionDays.description: Retention period of this recording, in days; 0 — unlimited. No field — Archive.retentionDays: the default for a new recording

rtspUrl.description: Camera address, readable and writable. Creating a camera without rtspUrl and without vendor, model — 422 VALIDATION_FAILED, field: rtspUrl. A camera under a recorder needs no address: it is reached through the recorder

serverId.description: Server: the server the camera and recorder are connected to (derived from recording storage), the detector computation server, the service server. Writable for eventsrc: without it the system chooses a server and warns in faultText; no move on failure

templateId.description: configMode: template. Copy stream resolution and frame rate, the streams themselves and firmware. Do not copy the address, login, password, name, recordings, folders, detectors or norm. A different model or no camera — 422 VALIDATION_FAILED, field: templateId
